description: Per-pattern verdict on eng/ci/aot-suppression-baseline.json suppressions. Keyed by (file, warningId, justification) -- deliberately line-number-free so line drift never invalidates a verdict. One entry covers every baseline row sharing that exact triple. verdict is one of: PROVABLY-SAFE (the annotated call demonstrably reaches no reflection under any supported composition -- cite the callee/control), SHOULD-PROPAGATE (the reflection is real and not reaching the consumer anywhere; convert suppress->Requires* and remove the baseline row), UNCLASSIFIED-NEEDS-OWNER (outside this lane's packages; gate stays red until the owning lane classifies it). Gated by eng/ci/aot-suppression-classification-gate.py -- an unclassified baseline row or a stale entry is a gate FAILURE, not a warning.

classifications.mechanism: VOIDED per architecture ruling, then re-derived behaviourally. The prior SHOULD-PROPAGATE verdict was wrong on two independent grounds: (1) its evidence was a grep for '.Bind(' / '.Get<', which structurally cannot match '.BindConfiguration(' -- the form 237 src files use against 103 for '.Bind('; (2) configuration binding in this repository is NOT reflective at all -- Directory.Build.props enables the Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.Binder source generator repo-wide, so binds are intercepted at compile time and replaced with generated code. Deciding it needs a strip of this single site plus a rebuild. Left to an owner rather than guessed -- the instrument answers per (file, code), the verdict is per row.
